# ghost/music

Fossify Music Player (offline, no account): list on-device tracks, play a track for a few seconds then pause, read what is playing, pause playback.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/music
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/music list_tracks --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/music play_track --device <serial> --param title=<title>
ghost skill run ghost/music get_now_playing --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/music pause_playback --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `list_tracks`: What songs do I have on my phone?
- `play_track`: Play Ghost Tone A440 for a few seconds
- `get_now_playing`: What song is playing?
- `pause_playback`: Pause the music
